name: KEB Berhad
overview: KEB Berhad 今年进行了首次公开募股（IPO），并在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市，发行 138,535,000 股新股。公司业务仍以房地产开发与销售为主，未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约事项。
overview_en: KEB Berhad conducted an initial public offering (IPO) this year and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad, involving a public issue of 138,535,000 new ordinary shares. The company's business remains focused on property development and sales, with no other announcements regarding expansion, reduction, or contracts in other business segments.

segments.name: 房地产开发与销售
segments.note: 今年公司完成 IPO 并在 ACE 市场上市，业务本身无其他公告动态。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market this year; no other announcements regarding the business itself.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
actions.text: 进行首次公开募股，公开发行 138,535,000 股新股，并在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市。
actions.text_en: Conducted an initial public offering involving a public issue of 138,535,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

model_changes.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
model_changes.text: 公司通过 IPO 在 ACE 市场上市，成为上市公司。
